name: Shipment On Water Report with status
query:
SELECT
    tol.po_number AS `PO Number:Data:130`,
    sp.partner_name AS `Supplier:Data:200`,
    p.group AS `Group:Data:100`,
    tor.dest_code AS `Dest Port:Data:100`,
    v.vessel AS `Vessel:Data:150`,
    tor.container_number AS `Container:Data:120`,
    tor.equipment AS `Size:Data:80`,
    tor.etd_date AS `Ship Date:Date:110`,
    tor.eta_date AS `ETA Date:Date:110`,
    
    tol.value AS `Value On Water:Currency:130`,
    tol.exchange_rate_to_sek AS `Exchange Rate to SEK:Float:130`,
    (tol.value * IFNULL(tol.exchange_rate_to_sek, 1)) AS `Value in SEK:Currency:140`,
    
    po.order_purchase_currency AS `Currency:Data:90`,
    po.delivery_status AS `Dvy Status:Data:100`,
    cp.partner_name AS `Customer:Data:180`,
    po.dc_warehousestore AS `DC:Data:80`,
    tol.invoice_no AS `Invoice#:Data:120`,
    tor.workflow_state AS `Status:Select:100`
FROM
    `tabTransport Order Line` tol
INNER JOIN `tabTransport Order` tor ON tor.name = tol.parent
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po ON po.name = tol.po_number
LEFT JOIN `tabProduct` p ON p.article_number = tol.article_number
LEFT JOIN `tabPartner` sp ON sp.name = po.supplier
LEFT JOIN `tabPartner` cp ON cp.name = po.customer
LEFT JOIN `tabVessels Time Table` v ON v.name = tor.vessel

SELECT
    tol.po_number AS `PO Number:Data:130`,
    sp.partner_name AS `Supplier:Data:200`,
    p.group AS `Group:Data:100`,
    tor.dest_code AS `Dest Port:Data:100`,
    v.vessel AS `Vessel:Data:150`,
    tor.container_number AS `Container:Data:120`,
    tor.equipment AS `Size:Data:80`,
    tor.etd_date AS `Ship Date:Date:110`,
    tor.eta_date AS `ETA Date:Date:110`,
    
    tol.value AS `Value On Water:Currency:130`,
    tol.exchange_rate_to_sek AS `Exchange Rate to SEK:Float:130`,
    (tol.value * IFNULL(tol.exchange_rate_to_sek, 1)) AS `Value in SEK:Currency:140`,
    
    po.order_purchase_currency AS `Currency:Data:90`,
    po.delivery_status AS `Dvy Status:Data:100`,
    cp.partner_name AS `Customer:Data:180`,
    po.dc_warehousestore AS `DC:Data:80`,
    tol.invoice_no AS `Invoice#:Data:120`,
    tor.workflow_state AS `Status:Select:100`
FROM
    `tabTransport Order Line` tol
INNER JOIN `tabTransport Order` tor ON tor.name = tol.parent
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po ON po.name = tol.po_number
LEFT JOIN `tabProduct` p ON p.article_number = tol.article_number
LEFT JOIN `tabPartner` sp ON sp.name = po.supplier
LEFT JOIN `tabPartner` cp ON cp.name = po.customer
LEFT JOIN `tabVessels Time Table` v ON v.name = tor.vessel

WHERE
    tor.mode = 'Sea'
    AND tor.etd_date >= %(etd_date_from)s
    AND (tor.workflow_state = %(workflow_state)s OR %(workflow_state)s IS NULL OR %(workflow_state)s = '')
ORDER BY
    tol.po_number, tor.etd_date, tor.name;
report_name: Shipment On Water Report with status
